name: Fabric Keychain Sleeve (Proposed Alternative)
function: Small sewn keepsake sleeve intended to hold a keyring or decorative charm
creativeChanges: Suggest a two‑panel sewn sleeve as a keychain holder
Add 0.5 cm seam allowance on all edges
Add 0.3 cm hem turn for edge finish
Plan double‑turned open top for easy key insertion
Include overcast stitching on internal seams
Design sleeve size roughly 3 × 4 cm (subject to fabric limits)
Consider a small loop for keyring attachment
Recommend reinforced stitching at attachment point
unresolved: Fabric wear resistance after repeated use
Final sleeve dimensions within scrap area
Method to secure fabric to keyring without tearing
Weight limit the sleeve must support
User preference for closure (open vs. button)
